scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix packages/script-api-bridge && npm run build:library && npm install --prefix addon && npm install --prefix dashboard
scripts.build: npm run check:contracts && npm run build:library && npm run build --prefix addon && npm run build:dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run check:contracts && npm run build:library && npm run typecheck --prefix addon && npm run check --prefix dashboard
scripts.test: npm run check:contracts && npm run test --prefix packages/script-api-bridge && npm run test --prefix addon && npm run test:server && npm run test:consumer
scripts.test:server: npm run build:dashboard && cd packages/go && go test ./... && cd ../../server && go test ./...
scripts.server: npm run build:dashboard && cd server && go run ./cmd/bridge
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run server
